# Why does USD find only env_0 in Factory with clone_in_fabric=True, and PhysX has all 512 entities? How to avoid this?

> **Current answer:** The author confirmed that setting clone_in_fabric=True would create USD Fabric instance proxies for all environments except env_0, which is not present in USD Stage Traverse(). Thus, find_matching_prims() only returns env_0, and PhysX still has 512 entities. The visible workaround in threads is to set clone_in_fabric=False. Manually setting _num_envs to 512 is only to confirm dimension mismatch and should not be considered a general fix. Another user noted that disabling Fabric significantly slows initialization, but no alternative performance solution has been provided.

- ContactSensor (接触传感器)

## Problem and symptoms

- Why does ContactSensor find only env_0 in 512 Factory environments, and PhysX body count is 512 when _num_envs=1?
- find_matching_prims() returns /World/envs/env_0; ContactSensor gets _num_envs=1, PhysX body count=512, and initialization fails due to mismatch.

## Environment

- IsaacLab commit d6a544defb166a4c9b1fbd6261599a4b60b609e3; Isaac Sim 5.0.0; Windows 11; RTX 4090; CUDA 12.8; Driver 572.47; 512 env.

## Priority diagnostics

- Checked USD Stage traversal, clone_in_fabric configuration, and PhysX view.count; do not infer a single physical environment from the Stage tree only showing env_0.

## Possible causes

- When clone_in_fabric=True, other environments become USD Fabric instance proxies, not included in USD Stage Traverse(), while PhysX still creates all environments.

## Attempts

- The author manually set _num_envs to 512, and PPO runs successfully, further confirming clone_in_fabric. Another user confirmed that disabling the option causes initialization to be significantly slower.

## Effective fixes

- The visible workaround is to set clone_in_fabric=False; manually setting _num_envs=512 is only for confirming mismatch and not a general fix.

## Result

- The root cause was corrected by the author; no alternative performance solution for Fabric has been provided.

## Limitations

- The initialization cost of clone_in_fabric=False may be high; no thread provides a solution that retains Fabric while correctly discovering sensor prim.
